sentence: You mustn't to smoke in the hospital.
ruleVi: Must / mustn't + động từ nguyên mẫu không có to.

sentence: She have to wear a uniform at school.
ruleVi: Chủ ngữ số ít (she) dùng has to.

sentence: Minh has to gets up early every day.
ruleVi: Has to + động từ nguyên mẫu: has to get.

sentence: Tomorrow is Sunday, so you mustn't go to school.
ruleVi: Không cần thiết dùng don't have to; mustn't nghĩa là bị cấm.

sentence: You don't have to touch that pan because it is very hot.
ruleVi: Điều bị cấm, nguy hiểm dùng mustn't; don't have to chỉ là không cần.

sentence: You should goes to bed early tonight.
ruleVi: Should + động từ nguyên mẫu để khuyên.

sentence: Does she has to work on Saturdays?
ruleVi: Câu hỏi với Does thì dùng have to, không dùng has to.

sentence: We musts wear helmets on motorbikes in Việt Nam.
ruleVi: Must không thêm -s và không đổi theo chủ ngữ.

sentence: Did you must wear a uniform at your old school?
ruleVi: Must không có dạng quá khứ; hỏi về quá khứ dùng Did you have to?

sentence: You shouldn't eaten so much sugar.
ruleVi: Shouldn't + động từ nguyên mẫu: shouldn't eat.
